atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Declares design tokens as CSS variables; each one also generates the matching utility (`--color-strong` gives `text-strong`). `@theme inline` emits the value as written instead of resolving it, which is what lets a token point at another custom property.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind. Inlines the declarations of the listed utility classes into the current rule. Used here inside `@layer base` so element defaults share one source of truth with the utilities.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Registers an extra path for class detection, for template files outside the automatically scanned set.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Defines a custom utility that participates in variants (`hover:`, `md:`) like a built-in one.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Applies an existing variant's condition to the rules inside it.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Defines a new variant that can then prefix any utility.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Loads a JavaScript plugin, replacing the `plugins` array of the v3 config file.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Points at a legacy JavaScript config file for projects still carrying one.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4. Imports another stylesheet's theme and utilities for reference only, so `@apply` resolves in a scoped stylesheet without duplicating the CSS output.

atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v3 and earlier. Injects a layer such as `base`, `components`, or `utilities`. v4 replaces all of these with a single `@import 'tailwindcss'`.
